title: Two privacy fixes are only in the next app version; the app members get from Google Play still has both faults
what: The newest app version on main fixes two open problems: Delete my account now waits for a copy that is still sending, and nothing of a member under 18 is saved on MettleUp's server. Google Play's public page shows version 0.79.0 (updated 25 Nov), one version older, so every member still runs the app where a delete can be undone by a running copy and an under-18 profile is still copied to the server. Both findings are still open, and the release notes leave the fixes out on purpose, so nothing tells anyone they are not live yet.
expected: A privacy fix counts as done only when the version holding it is the one members get on Google Play; until then the finding stays open and is marked waiting for release.
fix_line: Release 0.80.0 to production on Google Play, then re-check both faults on a phone
